name: romance-text
description: Single compelling marketing paragraph for use in product listings and e-commerce descriptions.
system_prompt_additions: Write in a persuasive, retail-friendly tone that highlights the product's core benefit and use case. The romance_text should be 2-3 sentences maximum — concise and engaging. Do not include price, availability, or store-specific references.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
output_schema.romance_text: string — 2-3 sentence marketing description highlighting key benefits
